title: Sponsor a Chancellor
heading: BadCode Shorts ▲ Sponsor a Chancellor

beats.name: A. The advert
beats.blurb: Black-and-white charity advert playing on her old TV: Crispin, sad, 'only' £100,000; his second home has no second home.

beats.name: B. Her flat
beats.blurb: Pull back into colour: a freezing council flat at dusk (Jack's reference), the nan in coat and hat indoors, breath showing.

beats.name: C. The junk mail
beats.blurb: The letterbox clatters; she picks up a SPONSOR A CHANCELLOR flyer, Crispin looking even sadder.

beats.name: D. Poor bastard
beats.blurb: She looks at the flyer, genuinely sorry for him: 'Poor bastard...'

dialogue.picked: 1D (median card and 'keep your £3' cut; hardship f)
